SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / COUNT(*), 2) as yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 115
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_trip DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT 
  cls,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / COUNT(*), 2) as yt_per_trip,
  COUNT(*) as trips
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 91  -- Last 30 days
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY yt_per_trip DESC

}).reset_index()
